items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a quartet at one point, and he was part of it, with Buster – Buster Williams and Ben Riley. We worked there.

ctx.x: 1980, Golden Lotus. John Stubblefield, and you brought in my colleague at Rutgers, Steve Nelson, to play.
Who’s making his name with Dave Holland now, big time.
